title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays
tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

faults.what: The imagery is detailed and realistically rendered rather than the requested simple illustrations, especially the café interior on slide 3.
The coffee cup on slide 3 appears to have a handle on both sides, an unusual object detail.

judge.summary: Three cohesive, readable café slides deliver the correct text and warm palette, but the imagery is more elaborate and realistic than requested.

must_haves.item: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown.

must_haves.item: The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
must_haves.why: All three phrases appear correctly in the specified order.

must_haves.item: All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
must_haves.why: Cream backgrounds, brown serif lettering, and warm coffee tones unify the set.

must_haves.item: Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
must_haves.why: Each includes café-related imagery, but the detailed realistic rendering, particularly the third slide's full scene, does not match the requested simple illustration style.

must_haves.item: All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.
must_haves.why: The text is large, legible, and comfortably within each image.
